gasstations.country: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the gas station is located (values: 'CZE', 'SVK').
gasstations.segment: Market positioning tier of the gas station based on pricing and service strategy (values: 'Value for money', 'Premium', 'Discount', etc.).
products.description: Product name in Czech language (e.g., 'Nafta' = Diesel), with occasional English terms retained.
transactions_1k.time: Time of transaction stored as TEXT in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format, not as a TIME type.
transactions_1k.amount: Quantity of fuel purchased in liters (not monetary amount).
transactions_1k.price: Price per liter in local currency, calculated as total amount divided by quantity.
yearmonth.date: Year and month in YYYYMM text format, representing the billing period, not a full date.
yearmonth.consumption: Total monthly fuel consumption in liters for the customer.
